_note: Model order per agent role, from the check of 2026-10-18 (config/check_results.json). Order = fastest model that passed all tests first; every chain ends with Nemotron Super on the free nvidia tier, so a run still works if the Nebius credits run out. The verifier is a different model family from the lane agents (MiniMax vs gpt-oss). Caveat: this was one run of four small tests per model, a smoke test and not a quality benchmark. Removed: Kimi K2.6 and Qwen3.5 (empty JSON replies, cause not confirmed), Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (timed out on nvidia, failed verification on nebius), Qwen3-30B (writer test failed, slow tool call), glm-5.3 on nvidia (over 80 s). Nemotron Ultra failed the exact-quote test on both providers, so it is only a last planner fallback. nvidia is the free tier and was 3 to 5 times slower than nebius for the same model.

planner_writer.needs: Strong reasoning, long outputs, follows citation rules. Used by the planner, the drill-down planner and the report writer.

lane_agent.needs: Tool calling and exact quoting, fast. Used by the 4 lane agents (news, company, legal, science) and entity resolution.

verifier.needs: Strict judge of whether a quote supports a statement. Prefer a different model family from the lane agents so their mistakes are not repeated.
